name: pdf_export
description: Convert Markdown text to a PDF file

tools.name: export_pdf
tools.description: Render Markdown text to a PDF file using the system's installed Chrome (handles Japanese/CJK text correctly, unlike most Python PDF libraries which need manual font setup). Supports headings, lists, tables, code blocks, bold/italic, and links.

output_path.description: Absolute path to write the PDF to, e.g. /Users/you/Desktop/memo.pdf

title.description: Optional document title, shown at the top of the page.
